stories.perspective_two: Supporters of enforcement stress immigration laws must be upheld to ensure national security and legal compliance.

stories.perspective_one: Supporters view these projects as revitalizing and modernizing the city’s infrastructure and image.
stories.perspective_two: Critics argue that bypassing norms threatens historic preservation and undermines regulatory processes.
